title: Our Menu Options Have Changed (Press One Press Two)
style: tech house, 124 bpm, DTMF phone keypad tones used as melodic stabs, deadpan female IVR vocal sample, rolling sub bass, comedic robotic delivery, claps on the offbeat, pressing-buttons percussion, 336 hz subharmonic anchor, dancefloor IVR satire
lyrics:
[Intro — IVR voice over keypad tones]
(robotic) Please listen carefully…
As our menu options have changed…
They changed last week…
They will change again…

[Verse 1]
For billing press one
For billing press two
For billing press three
We never told you which billing is true

For account press star
For account press hash
For account press both
Then wait while we burn through your cash

[Pre-Drop]
For a real human being press absolutely nothing
Just scream into the receiver and hope for something

[Drop]
Press one — press two — press three — press four
The menu options changed and they'll change once more
Press five — press six — press seven — press eight
Three-three-six in the keypad, nobody's at the gate

[Verse 2]
For English say English, for English say yes
For English just whisper, the bot will guess
If you said something else, please try again
We didn't quite get that, beep boop, amen

[Drop]
Press one — press two — press three — press four
The menu options changed and they'll change once more
Press five — press six — press seven — press eight
Three-three-six in the keypad, nobody's at the gate

[Outro]
(robotic) Returning you to the main menu…
Returning you to the main menu…
Returning you to the main menu…
